sourceInterpretation: Official image reports IDFv6.1-dirty with unknown private revision. Fixed public fff9895c82d744c7237be8847347bdd1b07c6643 establishes WAITI field/mask/reset and cold PER/PES delay policy. Actual S31 FPU load/store EXT_ILL behavior still requires comparison; public soc_caps names the bug while vectors fallback also uses a P4-only configuration condition.

semantics.waiti: Reset0x50001,mask0xfffffe1f. Supported synchronous SE/PP sample actual status after completion when wait enabled; validate8-bit05/noaddress before array/WEL mutation. Disabled wait sends nothing. High stored command byte is unused for8-bit command.
semantics.framing: Wrong command,address or16bitcommand fails before backing mutation. Timing dummy is retained functional policy,not calibration or physical busy latency.
semantics.suspend: Wait-delay bits2/3 can be configured. Actual PER/PES bits0/1 and automatic engine bits4/5 remain explicitly unsupported. No suspended write is invented.
semantics.status: Host-only poll counter/lastsample; RD_STATUS remains explicit RDSR/RES latch per header,not aliased to automatic samples.
semantics.exceptions: Default runner limit0 stops at first exception. Optional0..1024 resumes the already-established architectural handler for at most that many exceptions with no recorded bus fault. No host PC/register patch,no skipped instruction. Guest can still fail or loop; global instruction budget remains.
unsupported: Physical Flash busy/write latency,analog dummy calibration
